_doc: APP-REUSE-1 (owner, 2026-11-20): every GitHub App registered through the connect links, read from the tick Worker's credential_events ledger (D1 ultrastable-org, account 81e3). App ids and slugs are not secrets. Exactly one app per role is active; the rest are superseded and hold no stored key. The live registry is the credentials table; seed/worker/src/auth/routes.js reuseApp reads it before any connect link registers an app. Consumers: tests/foundation/test_connections.py, seed/worker/test/auth.test.js.
superseded_default: the four superseded apps stay installed and unused: their keys were overwritten in the credentials table, so nothing can act as them. Deleting an app is an owner-account settings action with no API for an app that has lost its key.
